This is Tomas. He writes reassuring pamphlets for Kestria. At ten, the internet went down.
By noon, Borovia had mobilised. Tomas was asked to make the pamphlets more reassuring.
At one, the sirens. Tomas went underground, with the pamphlets.
At ten past two, a nuclear weapon was detonated over the Kestrel Point naval base.
Underground, an emergency meeting was scheduled to schedule the emergency meeting.
On day two, a ceasefire. Both sides argued about the table.
On day three, Tomas came home. The pamphlets were finally ready.
